Table 2 (publisher CSV export read through the page reader) has one row per specimen with header Voucher, Sex, TOL, SVL, TAL, TAD, HL, HW, SL, ED, IOD, EN, IND, AG, FLL, HLL; a species-label row 'Hypselotriton (Cynotriton) oolong sp. nov.' precedes the three oolong rows (CIB 121430, CIB 121429, SYS a009274, all M); the ED value is the tenth cell. The orphicus rows above them are not type specimens of oolong and are not filed. The Description of the holotype gives no ED in mm (the eye is 'small, not extending beyond lateral margins of head').
